_comment: Edit this file (or tell the agent in chat, and copy its answer here) to change what's immovable vs movable. Matching is case-insensitive and checks if the keyword appears anywhere in the event/course title.

weekly_planner._comment: Defaults for plan_week.py, which now runs every morning as a rolling 7-day planner (today through +6 days), not once a week. Edit freely -- these are starting assumptions, not fixed rules.

spam_filters._comment: Emails matching these (sender or subject, case-insensitive) are ignored when scanning personal Gmail -- prevents university/marketing blasts from being read as real tasks.
